text:
Faculty reviews
BUS135 - AZD (Dr. Mohammad Amzad Hossain) - RA 1st, 2nd and 4th slot
Sir teaches very well. He has a terrific sense of humor. Believe me, you won’t skip his classes after taking the very first class. He takes three quizzes. I found the first two quizzes very easy and the third quiz a bit tricky. One downside is that he doesn’t show the answer scripts of the quizzes (I’m not even sure if he checks those or not 
). He takes two mids and the questions are very straightforward. There are theoretical questions alongside mathematical questions in the first mid, so you need to memorize the definitions and properties of the matrix. But there are only mathematical questions in the second mid. The final is also relatively easy as he gives nine questions, and you must answer five. He also gives two assignments from his sheets; if you do those maths by yourself, that will act as a catalyst to clear out your concepts. To get a good grade, practice from the sheets he provides in the first and second mid. And for the final, solve the maths from the book. Overall, he is an outstanding faculty member for those who have already done matrix and calculus at their HSC/ A-levels. Even if you are from a commerce/humanities background and haven’t faced these things before, you can do well if you practice extensively. 
ACT201 - NNh (Nazmun Nahar) - ST 2nd, 3rd and 5th slot
Ma’am is arguably the best faculty for this course. She teaches well. She takes three quizzes, counts the best two, and there are two mids. The questions in the exams are neither too easy nor too hard. She gives ten assignments throughout the whole semester. And, of course, there is also a comprehensive assignment as per the departmental policy. Complete all these assignments by yourself, which will help you immensely in the exams. Try to be consistent in practicing maths, as the concepts don’t stay in your mind for long (if you have a background in science). Lastly, she curves A LOT, so don’t worry about your grade if you can’t score full marks on the exams.
LAW200 - IBD (Barrister Ishtiak Abdullah) - RA 3rd and 4th slot
Sir teaches very well and makes the classes very engaging. He keeps the syllabus very short. He takes three quizzes and counts the best two. There is only one mid. He provides relatively short handouts for the chapters, and if you read those carefully, attend the classes regularly, and take notes, you can score nearly full marks in the exams. This is why his sections remain incredibly competitive, so you can’t really predict your grade, as a lot of the students score similar marks in the exams. So, I would say, try to remain in his good books, or else you *MIGHT* get decurved because he has to follow his departmental guidelines, and there is a very strict threshold for giving A/A- to the students.
BEN205 - AdK1 (Dr. Anirudha Kahaly) - RA 1st and 3rd slot
Sir teaches well. He takes two quizzes and counts the best one and there is only one mid. There is a report writing, and different topics are assigned to individuals. You also need to deliver a Bangla presentation on the same topic. He takes a viva worth five marks and will notify about the topics earlier. All the exams are very easy. However, I found his marking to be a bit stringent for the literature section. Lastly, try to participate in his class, and your grades will be curved. See less
